title: Tech Trends 2019: Beyond the digital frontier
notes: Six trend chapters. Introduction: 'In the following six chapters, we spotlight emerging technology trends that, over the next 18 to 24 months, will likely offer new avenues for pursuing strategic ambitions.' Chapter 1, 'Macro technology forces at work', is not a trend: it reviews nine macro forces (digital experience, analytics, cloud, core modernization, business of technology, risk/cyber, and three newer forces: digital reality, cognitive technologies, blockchain) and is not recorded as entries. A closing chapter 'Beyond the digital frontier: Mapping your future' is not a trend. Published month not stated in the PDF.

entries.label: AI-fueled organizations
entries.quote: The number of companies following in the footsteps of AI pioneers will likely increase in the next 18 to 24 months as companies identify ways to use cognitive technologies to achieve strategic goals.
entries.subject: Artificial intelligence in the enterprise

entries.label: NoOps in a serverless world
entries.quote: In the next 24 months, expect more organizations to begin following their lead, exploring ways to use serverless to scale their DevOps practices and to build greenfield applications.
entries.subject: Serverless computing and NoOps
entries.note: Same paragraph: 'The goal of achieving pure NoOps environments may take several years'.

entries.label: Connectivity of tomorrow
entries.quote: the next 18 to 24 months, expect to see more companies embrace the connectivity of tomorrow trend by exploring how a host of advanced networking capabilities can be used to enhance products, services, and enterprise architectures.
entries.subject: Advanced connectivity (5G, edge, networking)
entries.note: Sentence begins on the previous page; quoted from 'the next 18 to 24 months'.

entries.label: Intelligent interfaces
entries.quote: During the next two years, more B2C and B2B companies will likely embrace aspects of the growing intelligent interfaces trend.
entries.subject: Intelligent interfaces (voice, computer vision, affective computing)
entries.note: Same chapter: 'the steps they take during the next 18 to 24 months will be critical to maintaining future competitiveness'.

entries.label: Beyond marketing: Experience reimagined
entries.quote: During the next 18 to 24 months, expect more companies to launch their own beyond marketing journeys.
entries.subject: Personalized customer experience and marketing technology

entries.label: DevSecOps and the cyber imperative
entries.quote: During the next 18 to 24 months, expect that working knowledge to grow
entries.subject: DevSecOps
entries.note: 'That working knowledge' refers to DevSecOps practices, which 71 percent of surveyed respondents said their teams lacked.
